tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Maguire, who places it in the NSA chief scientist's office during the Clinton years as a tech-transfer meeting, where the story speaks of a White House science adviser.
tellings.link_reason: Maguire's firsthand account of a meeting with Carl Sagan. The story is Michels relaying, from Maguire, a meeting with Sagan and a White House science adviser about a Venus anomaly, so it appears to be the same meeting.

as_told.title: Carl Sagan at NSA chief scientist's tech transfer meeting

plain: A man named Bob Maguire, described on the show as a CIA contractor, says he once walked into a meeting about something unusual on or around Venus and found that the room held "maybe the most famous venusian planet scientist that ever lived," Carl Sagan. Maguire tells it as someone who was there, and he places it in the office of the chief scientist of the NSA during the Clinton years, at a meeting about moving technology into wider use. Michels, retelling it later, puts the meeting with the White House science adviser "or something like that." If true, it would put Sagan inside a closed government discussion of a Venus puzzle.
